runs.text: Do Jews kill more? Let's check fourteen countries. You've heard it: Israel is a murderous society. So measure it like any country: murders per one hundred thousand people. Jewish Israelis: zero point eight five. Lower than Germany, the UK and France. World average: five point two. The US: five point eight. Brazil: nineteen. Mexico: twenty five. Now Israel's neighbours. The UAE: zero point seven. Saudi Arabia: zero point nine. Jordan: one. Egypt: one point three. Lebanon: two point two. Turkey: three point two. Syria: no reliable data. Some of the safest places on this list. Now the honest part. Israel as a whole: three. Above every neighbour except Turkey. Double its two thousand and nineteen rate. Most victims are Arab citizens: eleven per one hundred thousand, thirteen times the Jewish rate. Over half are organised crime, and fewer than one in ten of those murders get solved. The state is failing them. And yes, we kill too. Sometimes by accident, sometimes deliberately. Every number is a life. What should Israel do first? So, do Jews kill more?
